paragraphs.zh: 0.10 g (0.23 mmol) 3-Oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chlor-3-cyclohexanyloxymethyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoat, 1 Tropfen Acetoncyanhydrin und 0.04 g (0.39 mMol) Triethylamin wurden in 5 ml Acetonitril gelöst und über Nacht bei Raumtemperatur gerührt. Anschließend wurde am Rotationsverdampfer eingeengt, mit 5 ml Wasser versetzt und mit 5 M HCl sauer gestellt. Es wurde mit Essigester extrahiert, mit Wasser gewaschen, über MgSO4 getrocknet und am Rotationsverdampfer vollständig eingeengt.
paragraphs.en: 0.10 g (0.23 mmol) of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chloro-3-cyclohexanyloxymethyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoate, 1 drop of acetone cyanohydrin and 0.04 g (0.39 mmol) of triethylamine were dissolved in 5 ml of acetonitrile and stirred overnight at room temperature. The mixture was then concentrated on a rotary evaporator, 5 ml of water were added and it was acidified with 5 M HCl. It was extracted with ethyl acetate, washed with water, dried over MgSO4 and evaporated to dryness on a rotary evaporator.
paragraphs.notes: The mole unit is printed inconsistently within this one paragraph: '(0.23 mmol)' all lower case, '(0.39 mMol)' with a capital M on 'Mol'. Both are transcribed as printed and not normalised. All decimal separators here are points. The 4 in MgSO4 is a printed subscript, rendered inline because the transcription is plain text. 'Essigester' is the German trivial name for ethyl acetate. A small stray ink smudge sits just below the 'x' of 'cyclohexanyloxymethyl' on the first line of the paragraph; it is a scan artifact, not a character. This is the invention's own preparative example, not prior art.

paragraphs.zh: 1.0 g (2.93 mmol) Methyl 3-brommethyl-2-chlor-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoat und 0.28 g (2.93 mmol) Phenol wurden in 20 ml Dimethylformamid gelöst und mit 0.14 g (3.51 mmol) 60 %iges Natriumhydrid versetzt. Man ließ über Nacht bei Raumtemperatur rühren und engte anschließend im Hochvakuum am Rotationsverdampfer ein. Der Rückstand wurde in 16 ml Tetrahydrofuran und 8 ml Wasser gelöst und zusammen mit 0.23 g NaOH (5.85 mmol) 4 h unter Rückfluß gekocht. Anschließend ließ man abkühlen, engte am Rotationsverdampfer weitgehend ein und versetzte anschließend den wässrigen Rückstand mit 2 M HCl. Anschließend wurde mit Methylenchlorid extrahiert, die vereinigte organische Phase über MgSO4 getrocknet und am Rotationsverdampfer vollständig eingeengt.
paragraphs.en: 1.0 g (2.93 mmol) of methyl 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoate and 0.28 g (2.93 mmol) of phenol were dissolved in 20 ml of dimethylformamide and 0.14 g (3.51 mmol) of 60 % sodium hydride were added. The mixture was left to stir overnight at room temperature and was then concentrated under high vacuum on a rotary evaporator. The residue was dissolved in 16 ml of tetrahydrofuran and 8 ml of water and boiled under reflux for 4 h together with 0.23 g of NaOH (5.85 mmol). It was then allowed to cool, largely concentrated on a rotary evaporator and the aqueous residue was then treated with 2 M HCl. It was then extracted with methylene chloride, the combined organic phase was dried over MgSO4 and evaporated to dryness on a rotary evaporator.
paragraphs.notes: '60 %iges Natriumhydrid' is printed with a space between '60' and '%iges' and is grammatically uninflected after 'mit'; transcribed as printed, not corrected. 'Rückfluß' keeps the eszett as printed. 'die vereinigte organische Phase' is printed in the singular even though only one extraction is described; transcribed as printed. All decimal separators in this paragraph are points. The 4 in MgSO4 is a printed subscript. The paragraph is a preparative procedure of the invention, not prior art.
